test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row, facing north. A sits third to the right of C. Only four people sit between A and B. D sits second to the left of B. Only one person sits between B and F. E sits to the immediate right of F. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
Given 

A sits third to the right of C 

C _ _ A 

Only four people sits between A and B gives two possibilities 

i) B _ C _ _ A 

ii) C _ _ A _ _ _ _B

D sits second two left of B 

i) D _ B _ C _ _ A 

ii) C _ _ A _ _ D _ B 

Only one person sits between B and F 

i) Since one position on either dide of B is filled i can't be correct assumptions 

ii) C _ _ A _ _ D _ B _ F 

E sits immediate right of F 

C _ _ A _ _ D _ B _ F E 

So total number of seats are 12 

Hence correct option is **"Option 4"**
